selection_requirements: No duplicate presentation runtime or trigger ownership.
Artifact generation and visual QA have one accountable owner.
Installation, permissions, release lifecycle, and rollback are independent from LHE.
LHE remains responsible only for engineering work and cross-capability coordination.

positive_intents: Create or revise a slide deck or presentation.
Generate or edit a PPTX artifact.
Render slides and perform visual slide QA.
Prepare speaker notes tied to a deck.
negative_intents: Review a code diff or architecture document.
Plan or render an AI video.

required_evidence: An approved owner and unique trigger contract.
Negative routing tests proving LHE does not claim presentation-only requests.
Clean-room package validation with and without the extracted capability.
Stable-to-candidate upgrade and rollback evidence in temporary directories.
No broken references in selected profiles.
A release note describing any installed-content change.
stop_conditions: Ownership overlaps an installed presentation capability.
Extraction weakens LHE core safety or validation.
A selected profile contains a broken reference.
The implementation adds a provider, account, network, or publication side effect.

rollback_contract.proposal_rollback: Revert this contract and its tests.
future_extraction_rollback: Restore the three source paths to bundled-optional.
Re-run package, doctor, routing, clean-room install, and upgrade checks.
